youtube.title: This Game Boy Survived a Bomb. It Still Turns On. 🎮 #shorts
youtube.description:
During the 1991 Gulf War, an explosive hit the barracks where US Army nurse Stephan Scoggins kept his Game Boy. The fire charred and blistered its front – but Nintendo found it still ran Tetris. It was shown, still switched on, at the Nintendo store in New York for years, until it was retired to Nintendo's headquarters in 2023.

beats.text: This Game Boy survived a bomb. And it still worked.
In nineteen ninety-one, an army nurse took it to the Gulf War.
Then an explosive hit his barracks, and a fire destroyed everything.
The Game Boy came out charred, blistered, its buttons melted.
Nintendo switched it on. Tetris started playing.
For years it ran nonstop in Nintendo's New York store.
In twenty twenty-three, it finally retired. Its screen had worn out first.
